comment: muse.c use_misc() MUSE_POT_GAIN_LEVEL for a monster that grows into a genocided form (2438). A Priest reads a wished scroll of genocide for large kobolds and drops a wished potion of gain level. A ^G kobold follows him off the line, picks the potion up (monmove.c m_search_items()), drinks it, and grow_up() kills it: 'As the kobold grows up into a large kobold, he dies!'
